sections.text: CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment) — это практика автоматизации сборки, тестирования и развертывания приложений. Для Flutter-проектов CI/CD позволяет автоматически запускать тесты при каждом коммите и пул-реквесте.
| CI (Continuous Integration) | Автоматическая сборка и тестирование при каждом коммите |
| CD (Continuous Deployment) | Автоматическое развертывание на продакшен |
| CD (Continuous Delivery) | Автоматическая подготовка к релизу |

# .github/workflows/flutter-ci.yml
name: Flutter CI

on:
push:
branches: [main, develop]
pull_request:
branches: [main]

jobs:
test:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest

steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'

- run: flutter pub get

- name: Run unit tests
run: flutter test test/

- name: Run widget tests
run: flutter test test/widget_tests/

- name: Run all tests
run: flutter test

# .github/workflows/flutter-coverage.yml
name: Flutter Coverage

on:
push:
branches: [main]
pull_request:
branches: [main]

jobs:
coverage:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest

steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'

- run: flutter pub get

- name: Run tests with coverage
run: flutter test --coverage

- name: Upload coverage report
uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
with:
files: coverage/lcov.info
flags: unittests
name: flutter-coverage

# .github/workflows/flutter-multi-platform.yml
name: Flutter Multi-Platform

on:
push:
branches: [main, develop]
pull_request:
branches: [main]

jobs:
test-android:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'

- uses: actions/setup-java@v4
with:
distribution: 'temurin'
java-version: '17'

- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter test
- run: flutter test integration_test/

test-ios:
runs-on: macos-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'

- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter test
- run: flutter test integration_test/

test-web:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'

- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter test
- run: flutter build web --release

# .gitlab-ci.yml
stages:
- test
- build
- deploy

flutter_test:
stage: test
image: cirrusci/flutter:stable
script:
- flutter pub get
- flutter test
- flutter test test/widget_tests/
artifacts:
when: always
reports:
junit: test_report.xml
paths:
- coverage/

flutter_build:
stage: build
image: cirrusci/flutter:stable
script:
- flutter pub get
- flutter build apk --release
- flutter build ios --release --no-codesign
artifacts:
paths:
- build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
- build/ios/iphoneos/

flutter_deploy:
stage: deploy
image: cirrusci/flutter:stable
script:
- flutter pub get
- flutter build apk --release
only:
- main

# .gitlab-ci.yml
test:
stage: test
image: cirrusci/flutter:stable
script:
- flutter pub get
- flutter test --coverage
artifacts:
when: always
paths:
- coverage/
reports:
coverage_report:
coverage_format: cobertura
path: coverage/cobertura.xml
coverage: '/Total:.*?([0-9]{1,3})%/'

# .circleci/config.yml
version: 2.1

executors:
flutter-executor:
docker:
- image: cirrusci/flutter:stable
working_directory: /app

jobs:
test:
executor: flutter-executor
steps:
- checkout
- run:
name: Get dependencies
command: flutter pub get
- run:
name: Run tests
command: flutter test
- store_test_results:
path: test_report.xml
- store_artifacts:
path: coverage/

workflows:
test_workflow:
jobs:
- test

# bitrise.yml
format_version: 11
default_step_lib_source: https://github.com/bitrise-io/bitrise-steplib.git
project_type: flutter

workflows:
test:
steps:
- activate-ssh-key@4:
run_if: '{{getenv "SSH_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY" | ne ""}}'
- git-clone@6: {}
- flutter-installer@0: {}
- flutter-tester@0: {}
- flutter-test@2:
inputs:
- flutter_test_args: "--coverage"
- flutter-archive@1:
inputs:
- project_path: "."
- build_targets: "APK"

# codemagic.yaml
workflows:
test-and-build:
name: Test and Build
max_build_time: 60
environment:
flutter: stable
xcode: latest
jdk: 17

scripts:
- name: Get dependencies
script: flutter pub get
- name: Run tests
script: flutter test
- name: Run widget tests
script: flutter test test/widget_tests/
- name: Build APK
script: flutter build apk --release
- name: Build iOS
script: flutter build ios --release --no-codesign

artifacts:
- build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
- build/ios/iphoneos/*.ipa

publishing:
email:
recipients:
- dev@example.com
slack:
channel: '#releases'

# .github/workflows/flutter-full.yml
name: Flutter Full CI

on:
push:
branches: [main, develop]
pull_request:
branches: [main]

jobs:
unit-tests:
name: Unit Tests
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'
- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter test test/

widget-tests:
name: Widget Tests
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'
- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter test test/widget_tests/

golden-tests:
name: Golden Tests
runs-on: macos-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'
- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter test test/golden_tests/

integration-tests:
name: Integration Tests
runs-on: macos-latest
needs: [unit-tests, widget-tests]
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'
- run: flutter pub get
- name: Start iOS Simulator
run: |
xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 15"
- name: Run integration tests
run: flutter test integration_test/

build:
name: Build
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
needs: [unit-tests, widget-tests, golden-tests]
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'
- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter build apk --release
- run: flutter build ios --release --no-codesign
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
with:
name: build-artifacts
path: |
build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
build/ios/iphoneos/

# .github/workflows/flutter-parallel.yml
name: Flutter Parallel Tests

on:
push:
branches: [main]
pull_request:
branches: [main]

jobs:
test:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
strategy:
matrix:
test-group: [unit, widget, golden]
fail-fast: false

steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'
- run: flutter pub get
- name: Run ${{ matrix.test-group }} tests
run: |
if [ "${{ matrix.test-group }}" == "unit" ]; then
flutter test test/
elif [ "${{ matrix.test-group }}" == "widget" ]; then
flutter test test/widget_tests/
else
flutter test test/golden_tests/
fi

# .github/workflows/flutter-junit.yml
name: Flutter with JUnit

on:
push:
branches: [main]

jobs:
test:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
- run: flutter pub get
- name: Run tests with JUnit report
run: |
flutter test --reporter expanded > test_report.txt
flutter test --reporter json > test_report.json
- uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
if: always()
with:
name: Flutter Tests
path: test_report.json
reporter: flutter-json

# .github/workflows/flutter-codecov.yml
name: Flutter Codecov

on:
push:
branches: [main]

jobs:
test:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
- run: flutter pub get
- name: Run tests with coverage
run: flutter test --coverage
- name: Upload to Codecov
uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
with:
files: coverage/lcov.info
fail_ci_if_error: true

# .github/workflows/flutter-pr-preview.yml
name: Flutter PR Preview

on:
pull_request:
branches: [main]

jobs:
build-android:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter build apk --release
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
with:
name: app-android
path: build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
retention-days: 7

build-ios:
runs-on: macos-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter build ios --release --no-codesign
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
with:
name: app-ios
path: build/ios/iphoneos/
retention-days: 7

items: Запускайте все тесты в CI — unit, widget, golden, integration
Используйте кэширование — для flutter pub get и зависимостей
Используйте стабильный Flutter — фиксируйте версию в CI
Ограничивайте время выполнения — таймауты для long-running jobs
Тестируйте на разных платформах — Android, iOS, Web

# .github/workflows/flutter-cached.yml
name: Flutter with Cache

on:
push:
branches: [main]

jobs:
test:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
- uses: actions/checkout@v4

- name: Cache Flutter dependencies
uses: actions/cache@v4
with:
path: ~/.pub-cache
key: ${{ runner.os }}-pub-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.lock') }}
restore-keys: |
${{ runner.os }}-pub-

- uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
with:
flutter-version: '3.24.0'
channel: 'stable'

- run: flutter pub get
- run: flutter test

sections.text: CI/CD для Flutter — это мощный инструмент для автоматизации тестирования и развертывания. Правильная настройка позволяет catching bugs до попадания в продакшен и ускоряет процесс разработки. Начните с простых workflow и постепенно усложняйте по мере роста проекта.
